item.content:encoded: El presidente de Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, y el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, mantuvieron una conversación telefónica el viernes, según un comunicado del Gobierno brasileño. Durante la conversación, Lula reiteró la necesidad de negociar los aranceles, mientras que Trump sugirió que los responsables brasileños y estadounidenses reanudaran las conversaciones lo antes posible.

item.title: Three scientists beat J&J's defamation suit over talc research
item.description: A U.S. judge in Virginia has ruled that three researchers did not defame Johnson & Johnson by publishing research linking cosmetic talcum powder products to mesothelioma, a rare form of cancer.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: A U.S. judge in Virginia has ruled that three researchers did not defame Johnson & Johnson by publishing research linking cosmetic talcum powder products to mesothelioma, a rare form of cancer. J&J sued Theresa Emory, John Maddox and Richard Kradin, alleging that they defamed the company in a 2020 scientific article. The article said it reviewed 75 patients who had mesothelioma and had no link to asbestos other than exposure to cosmetic talc products like baby powder. U.S. District Judge Jamar Walker on Wednesday ruled in favor of the scientists, finding no evidence of "malice" in their article. The litigation revealed some "mistakes" in the data, but nothing that was obvious or ignored at the time of the study, according to the ruling. J&J said it would appeal, seeking a trial on its claims that the scientists made false statements about cosmetic talc and asbestos exposure. The three defendants are doctors who maintain pathology practices, and who have testified as plaintiffs' experts in asbestos litigation. The scientists' attorney, Liz Lockwood, said that the ruling vindicates her clients and strongly affirms the importance of protecting scientific speech. J&J has been facing a [USN:L2N3QF0U4 TEXT:"deluge of litigation"] over its talc products, and it [USN:L1N38W2IH TEXT:"sued the scientists"] before agreeing to settle those cases for at [USN:FWN43T12P TEXT:"least $5.5 billion."] The company showed that eight of the 75 patients in the 2020 study had been included in a 2019 study by another researcher, even though the 2020 study claimed to have an entirely new set of patients. J&J has also sued the scientist who published the 2019 paper. The researchers were comparing anonymized data sets and information provided by lawyers, making it sometimes difficult to detect duplicates, the ruling said.

item.title: Shadow banks enter a newly uncertain era
item.description: Loans to private credit funds and other lightly regulated lenders grew just 3% in the second quarter, from 9% a year prior. Reasons for caution abound. Yet these upstarts are now crucial sources of corporate financing, raising the stakes of a slowdown if their funding dries up.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Gandel
item.content:encoded: U.S. banks are taking a half-step back from the shadows. Loans from their domestic branches to non-depository financial institutions — a motley assortment of private credit and equity funds, mortgage brokers and financial technology upstarts — rose just 3% between the first and second quarters, according to preliminary government data aggregated by KBRA Financial Intelligence. That’s down from a 9% pace a year ago and the slowest growth in at least two years. As so-called shadow banks become increasingly crucial sources of corporate lending, a slowdown in their funding grows more worrying. Caution from depository banks is understandable. Private credit's problems, from heavy exposure to AI-vulnerable software companies to allegations of fraud in cases like auto supplier First Brands , have badly wrong-footed a vast complex of funds. JPMorgan boss Jamie Dimon memorably warned of further “ cockroaches ” hiding among lending markets. These shadow lenders have been the fastest-growing part of the financial system over the past decade and a half. In an effort to make traditional banks safer after the 2008 financial crisis, regulators effectively pushed them away from direct, on-balance-sheet lending to riskier borrowers. Consumers with low credit scores and highly leveraged companies increasingly turned to fintechs and private credit firms, respectively. Investors seeking higher returns amid years of rock-bottom interest rates were happy to provide the capital. Since the pandemic, a bit more than one of every two dollars lent to non-financial businesses in America has come from a nonbank, according to data from the Federal Reserve. Much of this growth has been financed by traditional banks. Loans to non-depository financial institutions expanded by 26% annually since 2012, researchers at the St. Louis Fed reckon . Signs of a pullback now abound. For instance, JPMorgan (JPM.N) began restricting credit lines it had extended to private credit funds earlier this year, Reuters [USN:L4N400101 TEXT:"reported"] in March. Combined loans outstanding to the industry from the six largest U.S. banks rose just 1.5% in the second quarter from the prior three months. Lending to fintechs and other consumer lenders fell 1.5%. Economic growth depends on the free flow of credit. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s upcoming official release of quarterly data will likely show healthy growth across 18 of the 19 lending segments it follows. The problem is that those figures, focused as they are on depository lenders, will partly miss what has become one of the most important sources of financing. What shows up thus far seems to indicate a shadowy retreat. Follow Stephen Gandel on LinkedIn and X . The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation is set to release quarterly official data on lending by the United States' over 4,000 banks, both public and non-public, on August 25. According to preliminary data, bank loans to non-depository financial institutions grew just 3% in the second quarter versus the first three months of the year. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Lula e Trump conversaram por telefone e discutem tarifas
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conversou nesta sexta-feira com o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, informou o Palácio do Planalto, no primeiro contato entre ambos desde que os Estados Unidos decidiram adotar novas tarifas contra os produtos brasileiros.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conversou nesta sexta-feira com o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, informou o Palácio do Planalto, no primeiro contato entre ambos desde que os Estados Unidos decidiram adotar novas tarifas contra os produtos brasileiros. De acordo com nota divulgada pela Presidência da República, no telefonema, de uma hora e 20 minutos, Lula questionou as novas tarifas, reafirmando que se baseavam em "alegações infundadas" e que afetavam negativamente tanto os consumidores brasileiros quanto os norte-americanos. "O presidente Trump concordou com a necessidade de preservar vínculos comerciais fortes e propôs que equipes dos dois países voltassem a se reunir o mais brevemente possível", diz a nota. O governo dos EUA adotou em julho tarifas de 25% sobre cerca de 4 mil produtos brasileiros, de acordo com um levantamento feito pelo Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços (MDIC), o que equivale a cerca de 18% das exportações para aquele país. A base da decisão norte-americana foi uma investigação sobre supostas práticas comerciais desleais, a chamada seção 301 da legislação comercial dos EUA, e que acusa o Brasil, entre outros pontos, de não controlar o desmatamento e dar vantagens ao Pix contra instrumentos de pagamentos norte-americanos. Poucos dias depois, os EUA também aplicaram uma tarifa de 12,5% alegando uma legislação fraca para combater o trabalho forçado. O Brasil rechaça todas as acusações. Este foi o quarto telefonema entre os dois presidentes desde setembro de 2025, quando ambos se encontraram e conversaram brevemente durante a Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, em Nova York, no que foi o começo de uma relação até então hostil. No telefonema, segundo o Palácio do Planalto, os presidentes trataram também da cooperação que Lula quer com os EUA para combater o crime organizado e sobre as guerras na Ucrânia e no Oriente Médio. Lula tem feito uma série de conversas com presidentes dos países membros permanentes do Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas pedindo que ajam nessas questões, entre eles Vladimir Putin, da Rússia, e Xi Jinping, da China. "O presidente Trump teceu considerações sobre as perspectivas de resolução do conflito com o Irã. O presidente Lula lamentou a inoperância do Conselho de Segurança da ONU e, a exemplo do que sugerira aos presidentes Xi Jinping e Putin, propôs a convocação de uma reunião extraordinária do órgão para encontrar saídas diplomáticas para as crises atuais", diz a nota do Planalto.

item.title: Turquía pedirá a Interpol una orden de detención contra Netanyahu en el caso de la flotilla de Gaza
item.description: Turquía anunció el viernes que solicitaría una alerta roja de Interpol para la detención del primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, en el marco de una causa penal nacional relacionada con un ataque contra activistas que intentaban entregar ayuda humanitaria a Gaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turquía anunció el viernes que solicitaría una alerta roja de Interpol para la detención del primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, en el marco de una causa penal nacional relacionada con un ataque contra activistas que intentaban entregar ayuda humanitaria a Gaza. Turquía, miembro de la OTAN, ha sido uno de los críticos más feroces del asalto de Israel a Gaza y ya había emitido anteriormente órdenes de detención nacionales contra Netanyahu por la guerra en esa zona. Ankara ha pedido en repetidas ocasiones que se adopten medidas internacionales ante Israel por lo que califica de violaciones de los derechos humanos y del derecho internacional. Israel niega las acusaciones. En mayo, las fuerzas israelíes abrieron fuego contra al menos dos embarcaciones de la Flotilla Global Sumud que navegaban hacia Gaza para llevar ayuda al enclave, después de que misiones anteriores fueron interceptadas por Israel en aguas internacionales. En una publicación en X, el ministro de Justicia turco, Akin Gurlek, dijo que se habían dictado órdenes de detención contra Netanyahu y otro sospechoso por cargos que incluían genocidio, crímenes contra la humanidad y tortura, en el marco de un proceso frente a 35 personas por la interceptación israelí en aguas internacionales. "En consonancia con las órdenes de detención dictadas contra Benjamin Netanyahu (...) nuestro Ministerio de Justicia ha solicitado al Ministerio del Interior que emita notificaciones rojas (de la Interpol) contra ellos para que puedan ser buscados a nivel internacional", dijo Gurlek. Turquía usará todos los mecanismos legales a su alcance para garantizar que Israel rinda cuentas por sus crímenes en Gaza, añadió. Una notificación roja es una solicitud dirigida a las fuerzas policiales de todo el mundo para localizar y detener provisionalmente a una persona en espera de su extradición. La Interpol examina las solicitudes presentadas por los Estados miembros antes de decidir si emite alertas rojas. ISRAEL CALIFICA LA MEDIDA DE "PATÉTICA" Al ser preguntada sobre la declaración de Gurlek, la oficina de Netanyahu dijo: "El patético intento de (el presidente turco, Tayyip) Erdogan de intimidar a los líderes y soldados de Israel, la única verdadera democracia de Oriente Medio, no llevará a ninguna parte". Turquía e Israel también intercambiaron críticas esta semana en relación con Siria, donde Israel llevó a cabo ataques aéreos contra una base aérea en la que, según dijo, podrían desplegarse soldados turcos, lo que provocó la condena de Ankara y las críticas de Estados Unidos. Siria ha dicho que no había planes de desplegar soldados turcos en la base. La influencia de Turquía en Siria, como aliada del presidente sirio Ahmed al-Sharaa, ha despertado la alarma israelí desde que Sharaa derrocó al veterano líder Bashar al-Asad en 2024. Ankara ha afirmado que la retórica israelí contra Turquía y sus acciones en Siria se ven avivadas por la proximidad de las elecciones parlamentarias que se celebrarán en Israel en octubre.

item.title: Raiders not quite ready to name starting quarterback
item.description: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue. "We got another week. I don't want anyone to be comfortable in their job," Kubiak said after Thursday's preseason road win against the Houston Texans. "It should always be that way for all positions. So, let's keep going." Mendoza, the Heisman Trophy winner and No. 1 overall draft pick, started the 22-20 victory and threw an 80-yard pick-six in the first quarter. He played the first half and completed 8 of 15 passes for 86 yards. "Coach Kubiak outlined for the team what the plan was going to be with the starters, essentially for Weeks 1, 2 and 3 of the preseason, [and] to keep it internally," Mendoza said. "That was something I knew going into the game was going to be a great experience as a first start in the NFL preseason, which is always the next step." Cousins, who turned 38 on Wednesday, did not take any snaps against the Texans after playing just one drive in the preseason opener vs. Arizona on Aug. 13. Cousins was 5-of-6 passing for 50 yards and a touchdown against the Cardinals, while the 22-year-old Mendoza threw for 97 yards and a TD on 10-of-16 passing. Las Vegas concludes preseason action at home against the San Francisco 49ers next Thursday and opens the regular season against the visiting Miami Dolphins on Sept. 13. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mexican governor accused by US of cartel ties returns to office
item.description: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha Moya, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States.
item.dc:creator: Kylie Madry, Diego Oré, Sarah Morland
item.content:encoded: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha Moya, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following [USN:S0N4040KF TEXT:"U.S. drug trafficking charges"], a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States. Rocha, 77, a member of Mexico's ruling Morena party, said in a statement posted on X that he was resuming his duties, and added that Mexican authorities found no evidence to support the accusations against him. The move appears to cap a remarkable turnaround for Rocha, who has not only avoided, for now, extradition to the United States but has now reclaimed the governor's office. It also exposes the limits of bilateral security cooperation: despite years of joint efforts against cartels, Mexico remains deeply resistant to U.S. actions it sees as encroaching on its sovereignty. In his statement on X, Rocha denied wrongdoing and cast the U.S. case as a politically motivated attack on Mexico's sovereignty and on the leftist movement led by President Claudia Sheinbaum. "I am innocent of the falsehoods that have been fabricated against me by representatives of the far right who sought, as is now fully evident, to damage the left-wing political movement to which I belong and whose principles I fully embrace and represent. Today I return to my responsibilities as Governor of Sinaloa with a clear conscience, my head held high, and the truth on my side." The U.S. State Department, Mexico's Attorney General's Office and the Mexican presidency did not immediately respond to requests for comment. RARE CHARGES AGAINST GOVERNOR In April, U.S. prosecutors alleged Rocha and nine other current and former officials conspired with a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel known as Los Chapitos, helping it traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for political support and bribes. The indictment marked a rare expansion of anti-cartel action beyond drug bosses to include a sitting senior Mexican politician. Washington has frequently accused Mexican politicians of having ties to organized crime, but Rocha is the first sitting governor to face charges by the U.S. The accusations inflamed tensions between the countries, which are close allies. Even as Mexican authorities initiated their own investigation into Rocha in early May, Sheinbaum framed the case as [USN:L1N4290RL TEXT:"foreign interference"] by the U.S. and used it to intensify her calls for national sovereignty. Since then, Mexico has said Washington had not provided sufficient evidence to justify Rocha's arrest or extradition. "It's difficult to imagine Rocha returning to office without President Sheinbaum's blessing. It's a sign that the government wants to reinforce its message that there is no evidence of collusion between Morena politicians and organized crime," said Antonio Ocaranza, a political consultant and former spokesperson for former Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo. "The big question is how the U.S. government will react to this decision." David Mora, a senior analyst for the International Crisis Group, said Rocha's return to power puts Sheinbaum in an "even more complicated position because now she's going to have to deal with more pressure coming from the U.S."

item.title: Tesla e outras empresas iniciam recall recorde de veículos na China
item.description: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país.
item.dc:creator: Qiaoyi Li, Ju-min Park
item.content:encoded: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país. As medidas corretivas do recall vão desde atualizações de software até etiquetas de aviso e marcações aprimoradas ao redor das maçanetas das portas. Pequim intensificou este ano a fiscalização do setor de veículos elétricos e introduziu requisitos de segurança mais rigorosos, à medida que as montadoras, envolvidas em uma acirrada guerra de preços, lançam novas tecnologias no maior mercado automotivo do mundo. A China também anunciou que proibirá maçanetas ocultas a partir de 2027, tornando-se o primeiro país a eliminar gradualmente um design popularizado pela Tesla e amplamente adotado pelos fabricantes chineses de veículos elétricos. A Tesla não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário, enquanto Geely e Xpeng se recusaram a comentar. A Xiaomi afirmou não ter informações adicionais além do aviso regulatório. A Leapmotor disse estar comprometida com a segurança. A empresa explicou que a atualização envolvia apenas um rótulo de advertência e a atualização do software de controle dos vidros elétricos, mas que estava “gerenciando e registrando o processo de acordo com o procedimento de recall por uma questão de responsabilidade para com nossos usuários”. A maioria das medidas, classificadas como recalls de produtos sob as regulamentações chinesas, visa as alças mecânicas de abertura de emergência das portas que, segundo os reguladores, podem ser difíceis de localizar ou acionar em caso de acidente — um defeito que tem sido alvo de escrutínio após vários casos de passageiros presos dentro de veículos em chamas. A mídia estatal chinesa noticiou em outubro que o motorista de um sedã Xiaomi SU7 morreu após um acidente e incêndio porque os transeuntes não conseguiram abrir as portas para retirá-lo do veículo.

item.title: Soja tem alta "expressiva" no Brasil e atinge maior nível em mais de 3 anos, diz Cepea
item.description: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea. Além disso, houve retração de vendedores, de olho em riscos climáticos do [USN:L1N44H12A TEXT:"El Niño"] para a próxima safra no Brasil e nas condições de desenvolvimento das lavouras nos Estados Unidos. "Esse cenário elevou a disputa pelo produto brasileiro", disse o Centro de Estudos Avançados em Economia Aplicada (Cepea). Os indicadores de preços Cepea/Esalq Paranaguá e Paraná subiram aos maiores patamares nominais diários desde abril de 2023, com o primeiro se aproximando de [USN:IGB7A6176 TEXT:"R$155"] a saca de 60 kg. De 13 a 20 de agosto, o indicador em Paranaguá avançou 5,2%, enquanto no Paraná subiu 4,5%. Na média das regiões acompanhadas pelo Cepea, os preços da soja subiram 3,8% no mercado de balcão (valor pago ao produtor) e 3% no mercado de lotes (negociações entre empresas). A demanda externa segue aquecida, sobretudo da China. No mercado doméstico, indústrias brasileiras vêm intensificando as aquisições para recompor e garantir os estoques, apontou o centro da Esalq/USP.

item.title: Reports: Marc Stad purchases lead stake in Wolves, Lynx
item.description: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday. Stad, the founder and managing partner of Dragoneer Investment Group, has been a minority investor in both basketball teams under the ownership group of Lore and Alex Rodriguez. "We have been working together for years with a shared goal of building the Timberwolves and Lynx into the best organization in basketball on and off the floor," Stad, Rodriguez and Lore said in their joint statement, per Front Office Sports. "Our priority is and always will be championships. Our new agreement, pending league approval, is an evolution of the partnership we have built together and strengthening of our commitment to our team and our culture. We will continue to work closely with (Timberwolves, Lynx CEO) Matt Caldwell, (Timberwolves president) Tim Connelly, (Wolves head coach) Chris Finch and (Lynx president and head coach) Cheryl Reeve and want to thank the fans and entire Minnesota community for your continued support. While we're proud of the great work we've done, there's so much more to do and we're just getting started." The reported deal will need approval from the NBA Board of Governors, which has its next meeting on Sept. 15-16. Per reports, Stad's wife, Elisa, will serve as the Timberwolves' governor and Rodriguez will remain a co-owner of both teams. Lore, in turn, will move into a limited role in the ownership group. Per The Athletic, he is stepping away from his role as governor to focus on taking his food delivery and takeout business, the Wonder Group, public. The reported transaction comes approximately 14 months after Lore and Rodriguez assumed full control of the Timberwolves and Lynx from previous owner Glen Taylor. Lore and Rodriguez bought into the Wolves in 2021 at a $1.5 billion valuation, with an agreement to purchase the team in full from Taylor. Taylor bought the club in 1994 for $88 million. --Field Level Media

item.title: ANP avança para monitorar mistura de biodiesel por notas fiscais eletrônicas
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras. Segundo a agência, o acesso aos arquivos eletrônicos das notas fiscais de biodiesel, diesel A e diesel B permitirá acompanhar continuamente as operações do mercado e identificar com maior rapidez eventuais descumprimentos da mistura obrigatória. Atualmente, o acompanhamento do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória de biodiesel é feito, principalmente, com base em informações declaradas mensalmente pelos agentes à ANP, por meio do Sistema de Informações de Movimentação de Produtos (i-SIMP), segundo a agência. "Como esses dados são enviados no mês seguinte ao das operações, o modelo não permite que a Agência adote de forma imediata os mecanismos de controle previstos na nova legislação", disse a agência. A consulta pública ficará aberta por 45 dias. O reforço da fiscalização ocorre em meio a preocupações do governo e do setor com fraudes na mistura obrigatória de biodiesel, prática que reduz a demanda pelo biocombustível e gera concorrência desleal entre distribuidoras.

item.title: Shakhtar to play Champions League home games at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge
item.description: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday. The Ukrainian champions have been unable to use their Donbas Arena since Russian-backed forces entered the region in 2014 and were further displaced by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since leaving Donetsk, Shakhtar have played domestic matches in Kyiv and Lviv, while hosting European fixtures in Hamburg, Warsaw, Gelsenkirchen, Krakow and Ljubljana. The move to London comes after Chelsea failed to qualify for European competition following a 10th-placed Premier League finish last season, leaving Stamford Bridge available for Shakhtar's Champions League campaign. "We are grateful to Chelsea Football Club for the opportunity to host our games at this special venue," Shakhtar said in a statement. "Stamford Bridge is one of the most famous stadiums in world football, with an incredible history and atmosphere. "We are convinced that Shakhtar's matches in London will provide unforgettable emotions for Ukrainian and English fans." Chelsea were formerly owned by Russian oligarch [USN:L8N3XN11K TEXT:"Roman Abramovich"], who was sanctioned by the UK government following Moscow's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, triggering the sale of the club to a group led by American investor Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital. Stamford Bridge has a capacity of around 40,000. "Shakhtar have played in countries across Europe and we look forward to welcoming them to London for their Champions League campaign this year," Chelsea said. "We will be working closely with the Shakhtar team over the coming weeks to ensure that matchdays run safely and smoothly for their team and supporters."

item.title: Turkey to seek Interpol notice for Netanyahu in Gaza flotilla case
item.description: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza. NATO member Turkey has been one of the fiercest critics of Israel's assault on Gaza and has previously issued domestic arrest warrants for Netanyahu over the war there. It has repeatedly called for international measures against Israel over what Ankara calls its violations of human rights and international law. Israel denies those charges. [USN:L6N41W0YA TEXT:"In May,"] Israeli forces opened fire on at least two vessels from the Global Sumud Flotilla sailing towards Gaza as it was making a renewed attempt to deliver aid to the enclave after earlier missions were [USN:L1N41E0DW TEXT:"intercepted by Israel"] in international waters. In a post on X, Turkish Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said arrest warrants had been issued for Netanyahu and another suspect on charges that included genocide, crimes against humanity and torture as part of a case against 35 people over the Israeli interception in international waters. "In line with the arrest warrants issued against Benjamin Netanyahu ... our justice ministry has requested that the interior ministry issue (Interpol) red notices for them so that they may be sought internationally," Gurlek said. Turkey will use all available legal mechanisms to ensure Israel is held accountable for its crimes in Gaza, he added. A red notice is a request to police forces worldwide to locate and provisionally arrest a person pending extradition. Interpol reviews requests submitted by member states before deciding whether to issue red notices. ISRAEL BRANDS MOVE 'PATHETIC' Asked about Gurlek's statement, Netanyahu's office said: "(Turkish President Tayyip) Erdogan's pathetic attempt to intimidate the leaders and soldiers of Israel, the only true democracy in the Middle East, will go nowhere." Turkey and Israel also [USN:L1N44H05K TEXT:"traded barbs"] this week over Syria, where Israel carried out [USN:L6N44F0E4 TEXT:"airstrikes"] on an air base it said Turkish troops could be deployed to, drawing condemnation from Ankara and criticism from the United States. Syria has said there were no plans to deploy Turkish troops to the base. Turkey's influence in Syria as an ally of Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa has stirred Israeli alarm since Sharaa toppled veteran leader Bashar al-Assad in 2024. Ankara has said Israeli rhetoric against Turkey and its actions in Syria are fuelled by the approach of a parliamentary election in Israel in October.

item.title: ウクライナ支援「有志連合」、24日に会合 ウ独立記念日
item.description: [パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - ウクライナ支援国で構成する「有志連合」は、ウクライナの独立記念日に当たる２４日にキーウで会合を開催する。

フランス大統領府によると、ゼレンスキー大統領が出席し、マクロン仏大統領、バーナム英首相、メルツ独首相が共同議長を務める。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のコスタ大統領も出席する。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）によると、シェケリンスカ副事務総長がオンライン形式で参加する。

仏大統領府は声明で「ウクライナがロシアの侵攻から自国を守れるよう、ウクライナへの支援を強化するという決意を改めて表明するだろう」とした。

item.title: 英裁判所、ヘンリー王子らに計954万ポンド支払い命令 プライバシー訴訟敗訴で
item.description:
Michael Holden William James
［ロンドン ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michael Holden　William James

［ロンドン　２１日　ロイター］ - 英高等法院は２１日、ヘンリー王子や歌手のエルトン・ジョンさんらに対し、大衆紙デーリー・メールなどの発行元に９５４万ポンド（約１３００万ドル）を支払うよう命じた。プライバシー侵害を巡り原告側が７月に敗訴していた訴訟について、原告側の進め方が不当だったと判断した。

英高等法院のニックリン判事は同日公表された判決で、英大衆紙デーリー・メールの発行元アソシエーテッド・ニュースペーパーズ・リミテッド側の弁護士費用として９５４万ポンドを８月２８日までに暫定的に支払うよう原告らに命じた。

さらにニックリン判事は、追加費用は「補償方式」で支払うべきだと判断。これはアソシエーテッド社が費用が合理的かつ相応であったことを証明する必要はないことを意味する。同判事は先月、ヘンリー王子やエルトン・ジョンさんら７人が起こした訴訟について、電話盗聴などデーリー・メール紙による広範な違法行為があったとする主張を退けていた。

アソシエーテッド社への支払総額はこの日は公表されなかった。当事者間で合意に至らない場合、同社の費用は別途の手続きで算定されることになる。

王子は６年前に王室公務から退き、米国に移住していたが、今月、妻のメーガン妃とともに英国に帰国する計画だと、複数のメディアが１９日に報じていた。

item.title: Gobernador mexicano acusado por EEUU de vínculos con narco regresa a su cargo
item.description: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, regresó el viernes a su cargo tras una licencia de más de tres meses a raíz de las acusaciones de narcotráfico presentadas por Estados Unidos, que alegan vínculos con el Cártel de Sinaloa, en una medida que, según analistas, podría exacerbar las tensiones entre los países vecinos.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré
item.content:encoded: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, regresó el viernes a su cargo tras una licencia de más de tres meses a raíz de las acusaciones de narcotráfico presentadas por Estados Unidos, que alegan vínculos con el Cártel de Sinaloa, en una medida que, según analistas, podría exacerbar las tensiones entre los países vecinos. Rocha, de 77 años y miembro del gobernante partido Morena, dijo que retomaba sus funciones luego de que las autoridades mexicanas no encontraran pruebas que respaldaran las acusaciones en su contra. En un comunicado publicado en X, el funcionario, quien se [USN:L6N41F05Q TEXT:"apartó temporalmente"] del cargo a principios de mayo, negó haber cometido delito alguno y calificó el caso estadounidense como un ataque con motivaciones políticas contra la soberanía de México y contra el movimiento de izquierda liderado por la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum. "Durante el lapso que comprendió mi licencia temporal del cargo (...) me puse a la orden del sistema de justicia de nuestro país para ser investigado de las falsas acusaciones, que con motivaciones políticas e injerencistas de la ultraderecha nacional y extranjera, me hiciera sin ninguna prueba, una oficina del gobierno de Estados Unidos, pretendiendo lesionar con sus dichos y calumnias nuestra soberanía nacional", dijo Rocha. "Sin escudarme en el fuero constitucional propio de mi investidura, a cuya protección renuncié por personal convicción, me sometí a la acción de investigación de todas las instituciones competentes del Estado mexicano", agregó. "Después de 112 días de investigación (...) no existen los mínimos elementos de prueba que sustenten nuestra participación en conducta penal alguna (...) soy ajeno e inocente de las patrañas que se han urdido en mi contra". El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. La Presidencia de México y la fiscalía general tampoco respondieron a solicitudes de Reuters. México se ha negado hasta el momento a actuar ante los esfuerzos estadounidenses para detener a Rocha, argumentando que Washington no presentó pruebas suficientes para justificar órdenes de arresto o extradición. Para los funcionarios estadounidenses, la acusación [USN:L6N41C18T TEXT:"de abril"] marcó una inusual ampliación de la acción contra los cárteles, que ahora incluye a un alto cargo político mexicano. El regreso de Rocha pone de manifiesto los límites de la cooperación bilateral en materia de seguridad: a pesar de años de esfuerzos conjuntos contra los cárteles, México sigue mostrándose profundamente reacio a las acciones estadounidenses que considera una injerencia en su soberanía. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegaron que Rocha y otros nueve funcionarios, tanto en activo como retirados, conspiraron con una facción del Cártel de Sinaloa conocida como "Los Chapitos", ayudándola a traficar drogas a Estados Unidos a cambio de apoyo político y sobornos. "Es difícil pensar que Rocha haya regresado a su posición sin el beneplácito de la presidenta", opinó Antonio Ocaranza, consultor y exportavoz del expresidente Ernesto Zedillo, quien gobernó México de 1994 a 2000. "Es una señal de que el Gobierno busca reforzar su mensaje de que no hay pruebas de que haya una colusión entre políticos de Morena y el crimen organizado". "La gran incógnita es cómo tomará el gobierno de Estados Unidos esta decisión", agregó Ocaranza, mencionando que, en las últimas dos semanas, dos personalidades de Morena han tomado decisiones que "complican" la relación entre Washington y Ciudad de México, haciendo referencia a una carta publicada por un hijo del expresidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador donde asegura que Estados Unidos le [USN:L6N44B0VX TEXT:"revocó la visa"] y los acusó de una "burda y perversa canallada". [USN:L6N3VV0W6 TEXT:"Reuters reportó"] el año pasado que Washington había revocado las visas de al menos 50 políticos y funcionarios mexicanos, en medio de la ofensiva de la administración de Donald Trump contra los cárteles de la droga y sus presuntos aliados políticos. David Mora, analista del International Crisis Group, afirmó que el regreso de Rocha al poder coloca a Sheinbaum en una "posición aún más complicada, porque ahora tendrá que lidiar con una mayor presión por parte de Estados Unidos".

item.title: Ataque duplo russo contra shopping center na Ucrânia mata 14 pessoas
item.description: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e mais de 120 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando dois drones russos atingiram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, informaram as autoridades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e mais de 120 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando dois drones russos atingiram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, informaram as autoridades. Vinte e duas crianças estavam entre os feridos no ataque ocorrido durante o dia na cidade natal do presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy, informou o governador regional Oleksandr Hanzha pelo aplicativo de mensagens Telegram. “Há 29 pessoas em estado grave, incluindo cinco crianças”, disse ele. Ele postou uma foto de fumaça preta subindo de um grande prédio industrial. Zelenskiy classificou o ataque como “absolutamente cínico e desprezível”, afirmando que um segundo drone russo atingiu o shopping center meia hora após o primeiro, em uma tentativa deliberada de atingir os serviços de emergência. “Ataques como esses são nada menos do que atos terroristas”, disse Zelenskiy no Telegram, instando o mundo a responsabilizar a Rússia. A Rússia está intensificando sua guerra aérea contra a Ucrânia, à medida que os combates no campo de batalha se aproximam da marca de quatro anos e meio. Na quinta-feira, 17 pessoas morreram em um ataque com mísseis balísticos russos contra a capital ucraniana, Kiev. A Ucrânia também intensificou seus próprios ataques contra a Rússia, visando instalações petrolíferas e infraestrutura logística para tentar minar a capacidade de Moscou de conduzir a guerra.

item.title: Doble ataque ruso contra un centro comercial en Ucrania deja 14 muertos
item.description: Al menos 14 personas murieron y más de 120 resultaron heridas el viernes, cuando dos drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos 14 personas murieron y más de 120 resultaron heridas el viernes, cuando dos drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales. Entre los heridos en el ataque, que tuvo lugar durante el día en la ciudad natal del presidente Volodímir Zelenski, hay 22 niños, según informó el gobernador regional, Oleksandr Hanzha, a través de la aplicación de mensajería Telegram. "Hay 29 personas en estado grave, entre ellas cinco niños", dijo. Publicó una foto en la que se veía humo negro saliendo a borbotones de un gran edificio industrial. Zelenski calificó el ataque de "absolutamente cínico y despreciable", y señaló que un segundo dron ruso impactó contra el centro comercial media hora después del primero, en un intento deliberado de atacar a los servicios de emergencia. "Ataques como estos no son más que actos terroristas", declaró Zelenski en Telegram, instando al mundo a exigir responsabilidades a Rusia. Rusia está intensificando su guerra aérea contra Ucrania a medida que los combates en el campo de batalla se acercan a los cuatro años y medio de conflicto. El jueves, 17 personas perdieron la vida en un ataque con misiles balísticos rusos contra la capital ucraniana, Kiev. Ucrania también ha intensificado sus propios ataques contra Rusia, dirigiéndose contra instalaciones petroleras e infraestructuras logísticas para intentar socavar la capacidad de Moscú para librar la guerra.

item.title: 米国株は反発、債券市場の安定で買いが戻る－ドル159円ちょうど近辺
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 21日午前の米株式相場は反発。債券市場が安定する中で買いが優勢になった。リスク選好回復を背景に、暗号資産（仮想通貨）の上昇も続いた。

S&P500種株価指数は週間の下げ幅を縮小。ナスダック100指数は5営業日続落の後、方向感を欠く展開となっている。ビットコインは7万7000ドル近辺で推移し、週間では3年余りで最大の上昇率となる勢いだ。

今週、大きく変動した米国債相場は小幅安。イラン大統領が米国との戦争終結を呼びかけたことを受け、ニューヨーク原油相場は下落した。

外国為替市場では、ドル指数が小幅安。ニューヨーク時間の早朝には3カ月ぶり低水準を付けたが、次第に下げ渋っている。対ドルでの円は早朝にドル高の影響を受けて、1ドル＝158円36銭まで上昇した。その後は159円ちょうど近辺まで伸び悩んでいる。

インフレや政府の放漫財政への懸念から債券利回りが急上昇した今週の相場の影響を、投資家は見極めようとしている。長期の借り入れコスト上昇を抑えるため、米政府が介入に動く事態となった。市場は現在、ベッセント財務長官が公表を約束している新たな財政健全化策を待っている。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのジョー・マーハー氏は「世界の国債市場で最近見られた激しい値動きがある程度落ち着くにつれ、米長期債利回りは今後数週間で安定するとみている」と述べた。

ただ、タームプレミアムは引き続き緩やかに上昇し、中期的には長期債利回りに上昇圧力をかけるとの見通しを示した。

原題：Stocks Rise as Bonds Stabilize at End of Wild Week: Markets Wrap（抜粋）

LONDON/NEW YORK, Aug 21 : Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said. The move comes almost five years since Allvue's efforts to list via an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange were thwarted by the end of a bull run in financial technology stocks in the fall of 2021. While many companies have struggled with subdued investor interest and depressed valuations in the years since, 2026 has seen a recovery in deal-making efforts involving specialized financial technology and data providers which have businesses resilient to the growth of artificial intelligence. Against this more positive backdrop, Vista has engaged bankers at Evercore and Barclays to explore sale options for the Miami-headquartered Allvue, whose products help manage investments, track performance and streamline back-office operations.

Discussions with potential buyers are at an early stage, said the sources who cautioned that no deal was guaranteed and spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential information. Vista and Barclays declined comment. Allvue and Evercore did not respond to comment requests. Vista formed Allvue Systems in 2019 by acquiring AltaReturn and merging it with its existing portfolio company, Black Mountain Systems. The company has since expanded through acquisitions, including private markets software firm PFA Solutions in 2024. Allvue now generates more than $200 million in annual recurring revenue, one of the people said. Allvue could fetch somewhere between $2 billion and $3 billion in the event of a sale, said the person and a further source, based on the firm’s annual growth rate of more than 15 per cent, margins exceeding 30 per cent, and valuations achieved by comparable companies in the sectors. By comparison, when Vista pulled Allvue's IPO in September 2021, it was seeking a valuation of around $1.7 billion. As well as broader sector tailwinds, Allvue should benefit from perceived scarcity value, given few of its peers are not already inside large financial institutions. For example, BlackRock completed its £2.55 billion ($3.5 billion) acquisition of Preqin in March 2025.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Lavouras de trigo do RS sentem excesso de chuvas, mas Emater mantém estimativa de safra
item.description: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira. "As lavouras de trigo apresentam desenvolvimento regular no Rio Grande do Sul, parcialmente prejudicado pelo excesso de precipitações, pela persistência de nebulosidade e pela baixa disponibilidade de radiação solar", afirmou o boletim semanal do órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho. "Apesar das limitações meteorológicas, o potencial produtivo permanece, em geral, satisfatório", declarou. A produção do Rio Grande do Sul foi estimada inicialmente em 2,2 milhões de toneladas, queda de 36,4% na comparação com a temporada anterior, com produtores reduzindo a área plantada, em parte por temerem os efeitos das chuvas associadas ao [USN:L1N42U0VD TEXT:"fenômeno climático El Niño"] no Sul do país. Com uma produção menor também no Paraná, outro importante Estado produtor, as importações de trigo pelo Brasil devem atingir patamares próximos de [USN:L1N44A11V TEXT:"recorde"] de mais de 7 milhões de toneladas em 2026/27 (agosto/setembro), segundo dados da estatal Conab. A elevada umidade no Rio Grande do Sul tem aumentado a pressão de doenças fúngicas, especialmente oídio, manchas foliares e ferrugens, que podem reduzir a qualidade e a produtividade. Além disso, eventuais chuvas na colheita também são danosas. "Nas áreas em floração, a elevada umidade do solo vem restringindo o trânsito de máquinas e reduzindo as janelas para a aplicação de fungicidas", acrescentou. Conforme o boletim semanal, as condições climáticas reduziram a taxa de crescimento e retardaram o desenvolvimento de parte das lavouras. A maioria das lavouras está em desenvolvimento vegetativo, representando 82% da área. As parcelas implantadas precocemente avançam para a floração, com 14%, e para o enchimento de grãos, com 4%, segundo a Emater.

SpaceX's blockbuster IPO has rekindled investor interest in the space industry, including in emerging areas such as orbital data centers. Here are some details: • Manhattan West led the round that included new investors Nvidia and Cisco Investments, alongside existing backers Benchmark, EQT and Soma, among others.

item.title: Ken Griffin's Citadel sheds over 80% of Situational Awareness' bets
item.description: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80% of bets from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Anirban Sen, Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80% of bets from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday. Situational, an AI-focused hedge fund run by former OpenAI researcher Aschenbrenner, sold the [USN:L6N43W181 TEXT:"bulk of its stock bets to Citadel"] last month after heavy losses in its tech holdings forced it to unwind most of its public equities portfolio. Citadel has since completed nearly 100 block trades totaling over $4 billion in market value as it shed positions in the portfolio, which Griffin said included the largest intraday block trades of the year in 10 different names. The firm, which has about $77 billion of assets under management, declined to comment. "Our ability to distribute this risk was central to our investment thesis. These moments highlight our ability to quickly evaluate complex risks, deploy capital with speed and conviction, and execute with precision," Griffin said in the letter. Citadel is one of the world's most profitable and largest hedge funds, and has built a reputation for [USN:L6N43X1DP TEXT:"seizing opportunities during periods of market dislocation"]. After a selloff in AI stocks, the Situational Awareness' portfolio lost 67% of its value in July, and was forced to unwind most of its $16 billion public equities book. Griffin and his top lieutenants had pulled an all-nighter to analyze the trading book positions of Situational and how liquid the bets were, Reuters reported last month. Citadel bought some of the Situational positions at a discount of more than 10%, helping stabilize the market on the last two trading days of July, investors had said. "A transaction of this magnitude could not have been completed without the extraordinary cooperation of the trading and prime brokerage teams at the banks serving both firms," Griffin said. Citadel Wellington, the firm's flagship multi-strategy fund, [USN:L1N4420KK TEXT:"gained 5.94% in July"], leaving it up 12% for the year.

item.title: Malaysia's JDT stay unbeaten for world record 109th league match
item.description: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday. Marcos Guilherme scored in the 11th minute, while Oscar Arribas and Shahab Zahedi each found the net in the second half as JDT picked a comfortable win at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. The win saw JDT surpass the 108-match streak that Ivory Coast's ASEC Mimosas compiled between 1989 and 1994, which the Malaysian club had matched with a 14-1 victory over Kelantan The Real Warriors in their final match of last season in May. The Southern Tigers have not lost a league match since April 2021 and have gone unbeaten through the last four Malaysian Super League campaigns. "It's a proud moment of my career being part of this amazing five-year run that has seen us go 109 matches unbeaten in the league, thus setting a new world record," JDT's Spanish coach Xisco Munoz said. "Our aim now is to keep this streak going and make the numbers even greater. Club CEO and former Liverpool Champions League winner Luis Garcia added: "I've played for and seen many dominant teams during my career in Europe, so I know how tough staying unbeaten can be no matter how strong you are. "Everyone just wants to beat you and treats every match against you like a final, same as how it is for JDT." JDT, chasing a 13th straight league title, have come close to completing a perfect season in recent years, dropping points in only one league game in each of the last three campaigns. The club drew 3-3 with Premier League side Chelsea in a pre-season friendly earlier this month. Having taken the first step in their latest title defence, JDT will look to extend their record streak when they face Kelantan Red Warrior FC on Wednesday.

item.title: Russell takes sprint pole at Dutch Grand Prix ahead of Norris
item.description: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season. Returning from the August break with an engagement ring and a fresh spring in his step, Russell produced a best lap of one minute 11.567 seconds to beat the reigning champion by 0.041 of a second and secure his third pole from five sprints so far this season. "It's great to be back here after the break. It's a circuit I love. It needs a lot of commitment," said Russell, third overall in the standings and 59 points behind teammate Kimi Antonelli. "It was a tough end to the first half of the year and I'm really happy to come back. "The lap felt really good. It all came together really nicely. It's always difficult these sprint qualifyings with just one shot on the soft tyre." LECLERC QUALIFIED THIRD FOR FERRARI Ferrari's Charles Leclerc will line up third on the grid for Saturday's race at the gusty seaside Zandvoort circuit with McLaren's Oscar Piastri fourth and Antonelli qualifying fifth in a damaged Mercedes after an early excursion into the gravel. Home hero and four-time world champion Max Verstappen was sixth fastest for Red Bull and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, Antonelli's closest rival in the standings and 50 points behind, qualified seventh with Alpine's Pierre Gasly eighth. The sprint winner takes eight points with the top eight scoring. The big points come from Sunday's main race, after Saturday's grand prix qualifying. "George is coming back. I think he feels so much pressure is off his shoulders after she (fiancee Carmen Montero Mundt) accepted his marriage proposal," joked Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff. Norris, winner of the last grand prix in Hungary before the break, said he could easily have been first or fifth considering the closeness of the field. "Maybe I could have just pushed it a little bit more, but otherwise the car has been performing well and looks like it’s continued its strong performance from Budapest," said the Briton. "It’s not an easy track to overtake (on) and the inside of the grid is a lot worse than the left side of the grid, so let’s see.” Antonelli went into the gravel during the first phase when he was only eighth fastest and Wolff revealed there had been significant floor damage that the team had patched up. "I had a couple of holes in the floor," said the Italian, who turns 20 next week. “When I came in, they initially said it was a loss of 25 points (of downforce). They tried to repair as much as possible, but definitely the damage was still there. I was struggling a lot in the low-speed corners." Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto qualified ninth with rookie Arvid Lindblad 10th for Racing Bulls. Liam Lawson, promoted from Racing Bulls to stand in for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull, qualified 11th while his Racing Bulls replacement Yuki Tsunoda was 12th. There was disappointment for Fernando Alonso at Aston Martin, whose hopes for a performance boost from the upgraded Honda engine were undermined by a rear wing problem on the Spaniard's car that left the double world champion at the back of the grid.

item.title: ONS eleva previsão para crescimento da carga de energia no Brasil em agosto
item.description: O Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) aumentou sua estimativa para a carga de energia no Brasil em agosto, esperando agora um crescimento de 6,3% no comparativo anual, para 82.791 megawatts médios, contra uma alta de 5,6% prevista na semana anterior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) aumentou sua estimativa para a carga de energia no Brasil em agosto, esperando agora um crescimento de 6,3% no comparativo anual, para 82.791 megawatts médios, contra uma alta de 5,6% prevista na semana anterior. Com o aumento do consumo de energia, o ONS reduziu sua previsão para o nível dos principais reservatórios de hidrelétricas do país, localizados no subsistema Sudeste/Centro-Oeste. A expectativa é de que cheguem a 58,7% da capacidade ao final de agosto, contra 59,4% esperados há uma semana. Para as chuvas que deverão chegar às hidrelétricas do país no mês, o órgão manteve a expectativa para o Sudeste/Centro-Oeste (93% da média histórica), enquanto reduziu para o Sul (180%, ante 184% na previsão anterior), Nordeste (62%, ante 63%) e Norte (61%, ante 63%).

Aug 21 : Arsenal have signed England international Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa on a long-term contract, the Premier League champions said on Friday as they boosted their defensive options. The 28-year-old joins the North London club in a deal worth a reported 55 million pounds ($74.94 million) including add-ons, according to British media. “I’m super excited. It's a privilege to be here and can’t wait to get started,” Konsa said in a statement.   “I want to keep winning, I’m hungry to win and that’s what I’m here for. It's a proud moment for me and my family to play for one of the best teams in the world.”

Konsa arrives at the Emirates Stadium after six seasons at Villa, where he made 286 appearances following his move from Brentford in 2019. A key figure in Villa's Europa League-winning campaign last season, he played 48 games in all competitions. Konsa also featured for England at the 2026 World Cup, starting seven matches and scoring in the third-place playoff against France which England won 6-4. He has 28 caps. The versatile defender is expected to play an important role for Arsenal this season as they deal with injuries to William Saliba and Jurrien Timber. Saliba faces an extended spell out with a back injury, while Timber has struggled with a groin problem since March and was not fit enough to represent the Netherlands at the World Cup. Arsenal begin their Premier League title defence at home to Coventry City later on Friday. ($1 = 0.7339 pounds)

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 21 : South Africa must keep their wits about them and ensure concentration levels are consistent to counter New Zealand's attacking prowess when the foes meet in the first of their four-test series on Saturday, said home captain Pieter-Steph du Toit. They are set for a potentially titanic tussle as the All Blacks tour South Africa for the first time in 30 years in what is billed as ‘Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry’ with the Springboks' power game against New Zealand’s pace and running prowess. “We know New Zealand are going to bring it with intensity,” Du Toit said on Friday at a press conference. “We really believe the line outs and the scrum are going to be something where we're going to have to perform well.

"They're going to try and test us, finding gaps if we switch off. We know they're quite fast and have very skilful players. They're definitely going to try and exploit this and come up with good plans as well. “So I would say we have to be alert at all times and don't get caught out.” Du Toit, World Rugby Player of the Year in 2019 and 2024, continues as Bok captain after Siya Kolisi missed the Nations Championship wins over England, Scotland and Wales last month through injury and was left out of Saturday’s first test at Ellis Park. The added responsibility will not weigh too heavily on his shoulders, Du Toit added. “We've got a very good system and with all our coaches and players around me it makes it much easier. “We've got so many senior players, people have played a lot for Springboks, a lot of test experience. "Being able to captain the team is a huge honour but it doesn't change anything for me. I'm still focused on my game and what I have to do Saturday is play well and the rest will take care of itself." A first four-test series in 30 years makes it a novelty for the players, Du Toit added, and one they were relishing. “I would say it's very different with New Zealand playing four back-to-back games in South Africa. “It’s a massive honour and privilege to be able to play against them and face the Haka. Now the older you get, the biggest dream is to keep doing it. “At the moment, I'm trying to do everything I can to keep that dream alive and to still be there and add value and contribute to the team. And hopefully I can do this on Saturday,” added the 34-year-old.

item.title: 中国、対外投資の管理措置を改正へ 投資家保護を強化
item.description: ［北京 ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　２１日　ロイター］ - 中国国家発展改革委員会（ＮＤＲＣ）は２１日、投資家の権利と資産の保護を強化し、海外でのリスクに対応するため、対外投資の管理措置を改正する方針を明らかにした。

ＮＤＲＣは改正案を公表しており、９月２０日まで一般からの意見を募集する。

改正後の規則は、企業や他の組織、個人による対外投資を対象とする。２０１８年に施行された現行規則は企業や非法人組織の投資に適用されていたが、その範囲を拡大する形となる。

ＮＤＲＣは、今回の改正は中央政府の方針に沿ったものだと説明。中国国務院（内閣に相当）が６月に対外投資に関する新たな規定を出したことにも言及した。

ＮＤＲＣの改正措置に基づき、中国は「重大な悪影響を及ぼす事案」に関する報告制度を改善する。これには、国や地域が「差別的」な措置を採用し、中国企業に技術やデータの提供、または株式や資産の処分を要求した事例が含まれる。

ＮＤＲＣは、改正された規則では、一部の国における政情不安などのリスクから投資家を守る保護措置も強化するとした。

item.title: Russian 'double-tap' strike on shopping centre in Ukraine kills 14
item.description: At least 14 people were killed and more than 120 wounded on Friday when two Russian drones struck a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 14 people were killed and more than 120 wounded on Friday when two Russian drones struck a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, authorities said. Twenty-two children were among the wounded in the daytime attack on President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's hometown, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said on the Telegram messaging app. "There are 29 people in serious condition, including five children," he said. He posted a photo of black smoke billowing from a large industrial building. Zelenskiy called the attack "absolutely cynical and despicable", saying that a second Russian drone hit the shopping centre half an hour after the first in a deliberate attempt to target emergency services. "Attacks like these are nothing less than terrorist acts," Zelenskiy said on Telegram, urging the world to hold Russia to account. Russia is escalating its air war on Ukraine as fighting on the battlefield grinds toward the 4-1/2 year mark. On Thursday, 17 people were killed in a Russian ballistic missile attack on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Ukraine has also stepped up its own attacks on Russia, targeting oil facilities and logistics infrastructure to try to undermine Moscow's ability to wage war.

Aug 21 : Aston Villa could lose Ollie Watkins after receiving offers for the England forward, who could become the club's latest high-profile departure, manager Unai Emery said on Friday. Villa's Youri Tielemans has joined Manchester United and Morgan Rogers moved to Chelsea for a British record fee, while Jadon Sancho, Douglas Luiz and Lucas Digne have also left.   "We have an issue with him (Watkins), it's clear. He's a player we have offers for ... I don't want to sell him, but it can change if it is a good option for him and the club and I can replace him in the squad," Emery told reporters on Friday. "... there are still 10 days left before the transfer window closes. We will see what happens but I am happy with him and if he stays with us then he will continue at his level."

Emery also provided an update on Villa goalkeeper Emi Martinez, whose future remains uncertain after reports that a proposed move to Juventus collapsed. However, the Spaniard stopped short of confirming whether the Argentina international had indicated a desire to remain at Villa Park amid ongoing transfer speculation. Villa have signed Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, providing additional competition and cover should Martinez leave before the transfer window closes on September 1. "We can share both. Is this scenario a bad scenario? We have two excellent goalkeepers," he said. "Martinez transmitted to us the possibility of having another challenge in his career, not just now but even last year. He was thinking that if he had the opportunity to change his challenge, then he could do it, but he stayed and performed fantastically." Despite the departures, Emery said Villa could rely on the steadfast backing of their supporters, whom he described as the club's most important asset amid a close-season of change.  The club have strengthened the squad with several additions, including winger Alejandro Garnacho on loan from Chelsea, central midfielder Joao Gomes from Wolverhampton Wanderers and attacking midfielder Johan Manzambi from Freiburg. Villa have also signed right back Aaron Wan-Bissaka on a season-long loan from West Ham United.

item.title: Paredes banned for 10 games after World Cup final fracas, Argentina fined
item.description: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the World Cup final while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the [USN:L6N43L0A9 TEXT:"World Cup final"] while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday. A brief scuffle erupted at the final whistle when Argentina midfielder Paredes shoved Spain's Gavi to the ground as the European champions' substitutes rushed onto the pitch to celebrate. Paredes faced [USN:L4N43V1U3 TEXT:"three assault counts"] while Molina faced two. Both players were also fined $90,000 each. Argentina’s Thiago Almada and Spain’s Gavi faced one count each of unsporting behaviour, while Argentina's assistant coach Roberto Ayala faced one assault count. While Almada and Gavi received one-match suspensions, Ayala, who had [USN:L1N43O15D TEXT:"apologised"] for his part in the altercation, was banned for three games, with all three fined $30,000. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) was fined a total of $321,000 for multiple disciplinary breaches during the World Cup, including the display by some players of [USN:L6N43I178 TEXT:"a banner"] declaring "Las Malvinas Son Argentinas" ("The Falklands are Argentine") following their semi-final win over England. The AFA was also ordered to play Argentina's next two home matches with spectators limited to 50% of capacity. FIFA had said using a sports event for demonstrations of a non-sporting nature was a breach of the disciplinary code. The fines were levied for breaches of the disciplinary code including use of a sports event for non-sporting demonstrations, team misconduct, and discriminatory chants and gestures by fans. "The FIFA Disciplinary Committee further determined that $100,000 of the $321,000 must be invested in a plan to combat discrimination," it said. "The implementation of part of the sanction (one of the two matches and $100,000 of the fine) is suspended, with a probationary period to apply." The decisions remain subject to appeal and the AFA said its legal department would request the grounds for the rulings from FIFA before filing an appeal. The AFA said it was willing to appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport, sport's highest court, as a last resort. Andres Paton Urich, the AFA's legal manager, told Argentine sports outlet Ole that their efforts were focused on reducing the length of Paredes' and Molina's suspensions.

item.title: Gold price gets US bond policy boost
item.description: Gold hit a three-month high as the US Treasury expanded bond purchases, weakening the dollar amid rising debt concerns.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Gold price gets US bond policy boost

Colin McClelland | August 21, 2026 | 8:01 am Markets   USA   Gold

The World Gold Council identifies how bullion benefits from economic policy. Credit: Adobe Stock Photo by monsitj.

Gold’s surge to about $4,600 per oz. this week may have further to run if US policymakers increasingly intervene to hold down long-term borrowing costs, according to the World Gold Council.

Bullion climbed to a three-month high Friday after the United States Treasury unexpectedly expanded purchases of longer-dated government bonds, weakening the US dollar and reinforcing investor concerns over Washington’s growing debt burden — which hit $40 trillion just this week after doubling in less than a decade.

The Treasury announced Aug. 19 that it would double buybacks of longer-dated Treasuries after yields climbed to their highest levels in years. The move immediately pushed bond yields and the dollar lower while sending spot gold up more than 3% to nearly $4,500 per oz., its biggest one-day gain since February. By Friday, bullion had climbed above $4,600, extending its rally to a third straight week.

Cambridge University economist Mohamed El-Erian said the Treasury’s action was “not yield-curve control (YCC) but it might be a step in that direction,” a view highlighted by the World Gold Council in a report on Friday examining what the policy shift could mean for bullion investors.

The council argues that the Treasury’s announcement reflects a deeper challenge confronting US financial markets. Persistent fiscal deficits require ever-larger bond issuance while a rapidly expanding stock of outstanding debt must also be refinanced. At the same time, some of the market’s traditional buyers are becoming less dependable. Foreign central banks are diversifying reserves, and investors abroad have alternatives offering attractive returns.

Hedge funds

Banks remain constrained by capital rules and corporate borrowing tied to artificial intelligence and data-centre construction is competing for investor capital, said Johan Palmberg, senior quantitative analyst at the World Gold Council . A growing share of Treasury demand now comes from more price-sensitive investors such as hedge funds.

Those pressures have left investors demanding higher compensation for holding long-dated government debt, Palmberg said. The recent rise in Treasury yields suggests markets no longer assume Washington’s expanding debt supply will be absorbed effortlessly, he said. Instead, the balance between supply and demand is becoming an increasingly important driver of bond prices.

If market pressures continue, policymakers could eventually consider yield-curve control, under which the US Federal Reserve would buy bonds to cap longer-term interest rates directly, he said. While the Treasury’s approach is being presented as a market-functioning measure, Palmberg suggested the distinction could become blurred.

“Just because it walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, doesn’t mean it’s a duck,” he wrote. “It’s monetary policy’s version of plausible deniability.”

Intraday reaction to Treasury buyback announcement on 19 August 2026. Source: Bloomberg, World Gold Council

The policy was used in the United States during the 1940s and has also been adopted in recent years by Japan and Australia. Unlike quantitative easing, which targets the quantity of bonds purchased and substantially expands a central bank’s balance sheet, yield-curve control targets a specific interest rate and can require much less intervention if markets believe policymakers will defend the ceiling.

How gold benefits

For gold investors, Palmberg sees three principal benefits if the United States eventually moves in that direction. First, yield-curve control would probably weaken the US dollar by shifting the adjustment away from bond markets and into the currency.

“The expensive US dollar is already facing pressure from several corners and YCC . . . could increasingly force the adjustment through the currency rather than the bond market,” he wrote.

Because gold is priced in US dollars, a weaker greenback generally makes bullion cheaper for buyers using other currencies and tends to support prices.

Second, capping government bond yields while inflation remains elevated would likely reduce real interest rates. Gold has historically performed well when inflation-adjusted bond yields decline because the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset falls.

Third, investors could increasingly view gold as protection against what economists call financial repression — governments holding borrowing costs below market levels to make debt more manageable.

AI issuance sourced from Dallas Fed  How AI debt financing impacts duration supply and interest rates – Dallasfed.org . Treasury issuance sourced from SIFMA Source: Bloomberg, Dallas Fed, SIFMA, World Gold Council

Uncertainty

“A Treasury market that clears at an administratively influenced price brings uncertainty because investors don’t know where yields would settle absent intervention,” Palmberg wrote. He added that “markets can be relentless. It doesn’t require aggressive short sellers . . . just an absence of buyers.”

Palmberg cautioned that the outcome would not necessarily be uniformly positive for bullion. A credible and temporary yield-curve control program could restore confidence in bond markets, compress risk premiums and reduce safe-haven demand for gold despite lower yields.

History also suggests such policies can be difficult to maintain. The US experience in the 1940s eventually collided with rising inflation and questions over Federal Reserve independence. Even so, Palmberg believes the broader investment case for gold remains intact.

“The debt mountain concern . . . remains one of the pillars of gold demand and any attempts to manage that burden not involving a reduction of debt or deficits are likely to continue favouring gold.”

item.title: Fifa pune Argentina por faixa sobre Malvinas e Paredes por incidente na final da Copa do Mundo
item.description: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de US$321.000 à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de US$321.000 à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo. A punição também se deve a cantos e gestos discriminatórios por parte de seus torcedores. A Comissão Disciplinar determinou, além disso, que a AFA dispute as próximas duas partidas em casa com uma restrição de 50% no número de espectadores. Também determinou punições a jogadores por incidentes ocorridos depois que a Espanha se sagrou campeã mundial ao vencer a Argentina por 1 x 0. A punição mais severa recaiu sobre o meio-campista argentino Leandro Paredes, que recebeu 10 partidas de suspensão e uma multa de US$90.000. Uma breve confusão ocorreu após o apito final, quando Paredes empurrou o espanhol Gavi ao chão, enquanto os reservas da seleção campeã europeia corriam para o gramado para comemorar. Paredes foi acusado de três infrações por agressão. A Fifa também multou e suspendeu os jogadores argentinos Nahuel Molina e Thiago Almada, bem como o auxiliar técnico da seleção, Roberto Ayala, devido aos incidentes. A Comissão impôs ainda uma suspensão de uma partida e uma multa de 30 mil dólares ao meio-campista espanhol Gavi por motivos disciplinares. A multa à AFA foi aplicada por violações do código disciplinar, incluindo o uso de um evento esportivo para manifestações não esportivas, má conduta da equipe e cantos e gestos discriminatórios por parte dos torcedores. “A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa determinou ainda que US$100.000 dos US$321.000 devem ser investidos em um plano de combate à discriminação”, afirmou. “A aplicação de parte da sanção (uma das duas partidas e US$ 100.000 da multa) está suspensa, com um período probatório a ser aplicado.” As decisões ainda estão sujeitas a recurso, e a AFA informou que seu departamento jurídico solicitará à Fifa os fundamentos das decisões antes de entrar com um recurso. A AFA afirmou estar disposta a recorrer ao Tribunal Arbitral do Esporte, a mais alta instância do esporte, como último recurso. Andrés Paton Urich, diretor jurídico da AFA, disse ao veículo esportivo argentino “Olé” que seus esforços estavam voltados para reduzir a duração das suspensões de Paredes e Molina.

item.title: テスラだけで300万台弱、中国が「ドア問題」で過去最大のリコール
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 電気自動車（EV）大手の米テスラなど、自動車メーカー9社でドアハンドルの安全性が問題になっており、中国で400万台余りを対象にリコールが実施される。この問題が原因でドアが開かず、人が車内に閉じ込められ、複数の死亡事故が起きている。

今回のリコールは世界最大の自動車市場である中国で、過去最大規模のものとなる。21日に発表された措置では、テスラが最多を占め、300万台弱が対象となる。

中国国家市場監督管理総局が発表した文書によると、対象となるテスラ車は電気制御式のドアハンドルを採用しており、一部の衝突事故ではこれが作動しなくなる可能性がある。これにより「車内の人がドアを素早く開けて脱出できないほか、車外からの救助活動にも支障を来し、安全上の問題を引き起こす恐れがある」。テスラはリコールの一環として、衝突後に窓を自動的に下げるようソフトウエアを更新し、緊急時のドア解除装置の位置を示す警告ラベルを貼る。

車体と一体化した格納式の電動ドアハンドルを採用した車両では、衝突が起きた場合に電源が失われ、車内に人が閉じ込められる事故が相次いでいる。テスラ車では、高速走行中に衝突した際は生存していたものの、車外に脱出できず、その後に起きた火災で死亡したり重傷を負ったりした事例が複数ある。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースは、こうした最新式のドアシステムについて詳しく報じてきた。テスラ車が衝突して炎上し、ドアを開けられなかった12件の事故で、少なくとも15人が死亡したと明らかにした。またブルームバーグは昨年末、潜在的な安全上の懸念が社内で指摘された後も、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（CEO）が電動ドアの採用にこだわったことも報じている。

中国がこの問題に強い関心を示し始めたのは、小米（シャオミ）の車両を巻き込んだ炎上事故が起きてからだ。同国は2月、EVの格納式ドアハンドルを禁止し、世界で初めてこの設計を違法とした。従来の自動車メーカーのおよそ半分の期間で国産車が開発されている中、安全性の向上を目指し、運転支援技術やバッテリーなどに関する規制も導入されている。

item.title: EPA plans to extend renewable fuel standard compliance deadline for refiners
item.description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) plans to extend a September 1 deadline requiring oil refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending laws, the agency said in a notice seen by Reuters on Friday, a move that could help the industry reduce the elevated cost of compliance.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) plans to extend a September 1 deadline requiring oil refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending laws, the agency said in a notice seen by Reuters on Friday, a move that could help the industry reduce the elevated cost of compliance. The agency did not give additional details on the new deadline, but said it would be included in an upcoming formal action. The EPA confirmed the notice and said in an email it "recognizes the importance of the RFS program and is committed to maintaining certainty and stability." Under the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), a federal program aimed at increasing renewable fuel usage, refiners were required to show they had met their 2025 biofuel blending mandates by September 1, either by generating Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs) through blending biofuels into the nation's fuel supply or by purchasing those credits from other market participants. An extension would give refiners more time to meet their obligations and could help them manage high RIN prices, which have raised compliance costs for some companies. The multibillion-dollar RIN market is a key component of the biofuel program and a major source of uncertainty for refiners. For years, farmers, ethanol makers and green fuel proponents have been pushing for higher blending quotas, while small refiners have resisted the push. Reuters [USN:L1N43V0KO TEXT:"reported "]in late July that the EPA was weighing such an extension. The agency on Friday also said it intends to issue decisions on all pending requests from smaller refiners seeking waivers from their obligations by the end of August, an issue that has put the White House in the middle of a fight between refiners and biofuel producers. Those decisions also had a deadline of September 1. Smaller refiners have sought waivers from their 2025 obligations, arguing that compliance costs have become too burdensome, as [USN:L6N426147 TEXT:"RIN prices"] have risen to record levels and the EPA has imposed more [USN:L1N40F0R6 TEXT:"aggressive "]biofuel blending requirements.
